<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

HiCache rejects non-MLA models with `--dcp-size > 1`, even when the model and attention backend already support DCP. This PR enables GQA deployments to retain evicted prefixes in the L2 host cache and restore them without recomputing the full prefix.
It extends the DCP L2 infrastructure from [#33112](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33112) to the standard MHA/GQA host pool, including Qwen3.5's GQA/GDN hybrid cache.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
- Pass DCP size/rank into the MHA host pool and preserve logical capacity accounting.
- Translate logical H2D/D2H indices to this rank's physical KV rows, using the same mapping for K and V.
- Preserve GDN checkpoint indices and account for physical transfer bytes per pool.
- Allow BF16 and FP16 KV; reject unsupported compositions and resolved quantized host pools.
- Add independent test cases to three existing test files: GPU copies, transfer accounting, and DCP L2 end-to-end coverage.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->
### GSM8K

Chat API, temperature 0, top_p 1, enable_thinking=False, max_tokens=1024, and eight client threads.

| Model | Compute / KV dtype | TP/DCP | HiCache off | HiCache on |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Qwen3.5-35B-A3B | BF16 / BF16 | 8/1 | 96.29% (1270/1319) | 96.36% (1271/1319) |
| Qwen3.5-35B-A3B | BF16 / BF16 | 8/2 | 96.21% (1269/1319) | 95.91% (1265/1319) |
| Qwen3.5-35B-A3B | BF16 / BF16 | 8/4 | 96.36% (1271/1319) | 95.83% (1264/1319) |
| Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct | BF16 / BF16 | 4/2 | 63.00% (831/1319) | 62.47% (824/1319) |
| Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct | FP16 / FP16 | 4/2 | 62.32% (822/1319) | 61.56% (812/1319) |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->
Hardware: NVIDIA A10 with PCIe interconnect. Software used for the recorded experiments: PyTorch 2.14.1/CUDA 13.0, Triton 3.8.0, Transformers 5.19.0.

Both experiments use 8 sessions × 2 scripted turns, a fixed 256-token continuation, and 128 output tokens per request. Inputs are identical across configurations; generated replies are not fed back. Cache is flushed before each case. No dedicated eviction requests are inserted into timed runs: pressure comes from the working set exceeding the configured L1 capacity.

Throughput includes both turns and the initial prefill. The latency values below describe the second, prefix-reuse turn.

### Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: long-context BF16 workload

TP8, Triton, decode CUDA graphs, `page_first/kernel`, 64K prefixes, concurrency 8. Each configuration was measured once. The GPU budget is deliberately limited to **196,608 physical KV rows per rank (~1.876 GiB)** and **128 GDN slots**; HiCache uses 20 GB/rank host budget. Logical KV capacity is multiplied by DCP size.

| DCP size | Output tok/s, off → on | Reuse TTFT P50 (s), off → on | L1 device-hit tokens, on | L2 host-hit tokens, on |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 16.44 → 26.18 | 35.209 → 4.811 | 0 | 524,288 |
| 2 | 17.97 → 31.08 | 24.814 → 0.384 | 0 | 524,288 |

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

         declare_resolution(server_args, "_resolve_hicache_key_scheme", **resolutions)
 
 
+def _validate_mha_dcp_hicache(server_args: Any) -> None:
+    """Reject cache paths that do not share the MHA DCP transfer contract."""
+    cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    unsupported = []
+    if set(attention_backends_of(cfg)) != {"triton"}:
+        unsupported.append("attention backends other than Triton")
+    # Triton DCP prefill currently mixes DP-local request IDs and lengths.
+    if cfg.attn_dp_size != 1:
+        unsupported.append("attention DP with Triton DCP")
+    if (
+        cfg.hicache_host_memory_mode != "cache"
+        or cfg.hicache_storage_backend is not None
+    ):
+        unsupported.append("L3 storage or buffer_only host memory")
+    if cfg.speculative_algorithm is not None:
+        unsupported.append("speculative decoding")
+    if cfg.disaggregation_mode != "null":
+        unsupported.append("PD disaggregation")
+    model = model_config_of(server_args)
+    if model.is_hybrid_swa:
+        unsupported.append("sliding-window attention")
+    if getattr(model.hf_text_config, "indexer_n_heads", 0):
+        unsupported.append("sparse attention indexers")
+    attn_tp_size = derive_attn_tp_size(
+        tp_size=cfg.tp_size,
+        attn_dp_size=cfg.attn_dp_size,
+        attn_cp_size=cfg.attn_cp_size,
+    )
+    # Qwen3.5 adjusts its K/V projections for DCP. Other models retain their
+    # TP-only projection layout, which must already match the DCP pool.
+    if not is_qwen3_5(model.hf_config) and model.get_num_kv_heads(
+        attn_tp_size, cfg.dcp_size
+    ) != model.get_num_kv_heads(attn_tp_size):
+        unsupported.append("a KV-head layout not provided by the model's projections")
+    if unsupported:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "MHA/GQA HiCache + DCP does not support " + ", ".join(unsupported)
+        )
+
+
 def resolve_layout_io_compatibility(server_args: Any):
     cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
     if cfg.hicache_mem_layout == "page_unified":

+@pytest.mark.skipif(not is_cuda(), reason="GQA DCP HiCache requires CUDA")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "dtype",
+    [
+        torch.bfloat16,
+        torch.float16,
+        torch.uint8,
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+        torch.float8_e5m2,
+    ],
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "layout, io", [("page_first", "kernel"), ("page_first_direct", "direct")]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dcp_size, dcp_rank", [(1, 0), (2, 1), (4, 3)])
+def test_gqa_dcp_kv_roundtrip(dtype, layout, io, dcp_size, dcp_rank):
+    pool = MHATokenToKVPool(
+        size=128,
+        page_size=16,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        head_num=1,
+        head_dim=128,
+        layer_num=2,
+        device="cuda",
+        enable_memory_saver=False,
+    )
+    host = MHATokenToKVPoolHost(
+        pool.get_device_pool_infos()[0].buffer_info,
+        host_to_device_ratio=2,
+        host_size=0,
+        page_size=16 * dcp_size,
+        layout=layout,
+        device_capacity_tokens=pool.size,
+        start_layer=0,
+        end_layer=2,
+        dcp_size=dcp_size,
+        dcp_rank=dcp_rank,
+    )
+
+    def indices(pages, page_size=16, device="cuda"):
+        return (
+            torch.tensor(pages, device=device)[:, None] * page_size
+            + torch.arange(page_size, device=device)
+        ).flatten()
+
+    try:
+        buffers = [*pool.k_buffer, *pool.v_buffer]
+        for i, buffer in enumerate(buffers):
+            values = torch.arange(buffer.numel(), device="cuda").reshape_as(buffer)
+            buffer.copy_((values + i * 37) % 256)
+        source, target = [7, 1, 3], [4, 5, 6]
+        host_pages = [host.page_num - 1, 2, 0]
+        expected = [buffer[indices(source)].clone() for buffer in buffers]
+        logical_page = 16 * dcp_size
+        index_device = "cuda" if io == "kernel" else "cpu"
+        host_ids = indices(host_pages, logical_page, index_device)
+        # Direct IO uses cudaMemcpyBatchAsync, which requires a non-default stream.
+        stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            host.backup_from_device_all_layer(
+                pool,
+                host_ids.cpu() if host.can_use_write_back_jit else host_ids,
+                indices(source, logical_page, index_device),
+                io,
+            )
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        for buffer, values in zip([*host.k_data_refs, *host.v_data_refs], expected):
+            host_rows = buffer.reshape(-1, *values.shape[1:])
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                host_rows[indices(host_pages, device="cpu")],
+                values.cpu(),
+                rtol=0,
+                atol=0,
+            )
+        for buffer in buffers:
+            buffer.fill_(-1)
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            for layer in range(2):
+                host.load_to_device_per_layer(
+                    pool,
+                    host_ids,
+                    indices(target, logical_page, index_device),
+                    layer,
+                    io,
+                )
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        for buffer, values in zip(buffers, expected):
+            restored = torch.full_like(buffer, -1)
+            restored[indices(target)] = values
+            torch.testing.assert_close(buffer, restored, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    finally:
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        host.destroy()
+
+
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("layout", LAYOUTS)
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("element_dim", MLA_ELEMENT_DIMS)
 def test_hicache_transfer_mla(layout: str, element_dim: int) -> None:

@@ -4,18 +4,28 @@
 buffers hold only its 1/dcp_size shard, so a missing translation makes cache
 hits return another rank's KV. The KL cases catch that as a large divergence.
 
-Blackwell-only: ``cutedsl_mla`` is the DCP-native MLA decode kernel on SM100.
+The MLA case requires Blackwell for ``cutedsl_mla``. The GQA case uses Triton.
 """
 
+import math
+import os
+import shlex
 import unittest
 
+import requests
+
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
 from sglang.test.kits.unified_radix_cache_kit import UnifiedRadixTreeTestMixin
 from sglang.test.kl_multiturn_utils import (
     get_input_ids,
     make_mamba_decode_assert,
     make_mamba_prefill_assert,
 )
+from sglang.test.kl_test_utils import (
+    _extract_output_logprobs,
+    _flush_cache,
+    _generate,
+)
 from sglang.test.test_utils import (
     DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
     DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
@@ -101,5 +111,63 @@ def tearDownClass(cls):
         terminate_and_kill_process_tree(cls.process, wait_timeout=60)
 
 
+class TestGqaDcpHiCache(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        model = os.environ.get("GQA_DCP_HICACHE_MODEL", "Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct")
+        cls.base_url = os.environ.get("GQA_DCP_HICACHE_BASE_URL", DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST)
+        dtype = os.environ.get("GQA_DCP_HICACHE_DTYPE", "bfloat16")
+        kv_dtype = {"bfloat16": "bf16", "float16": "auto"}[dtype]
+        if "GQA_DCP_HICACHE_BASE_URL" not in os.environ:
+            process = popen_launch_server(
+                model,
+                cls.base_url,
+                timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+                other_args=shlex.split(
+                    "--tp-size 4 --dcp-size 2 --attention-backend triton "
+                    f"--dtype {dtype} --kv-cache-dtype {kv_dtype} --page-size 64 "
+                    "--max-total-tokens 4096 --max-running-requests 4 "
+                    "--chunked-prefill-size 1024 --enable-hierarchical-cache "
+                    "--hicache-size 2 --hicache-write-policy write_through "
+                    "--hicache-mem-layout page_first_direct --hicache-io-backend direct "
+                    "--enable-cache-report --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled "
+                    "--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 4"
+                ),
+            )
+            cls.addClassCleanup(terminate_and_kill_process_tree, process)
+        info = requests.get(cls.base_url + "/get_server_info", timeout=30).json()
+        assert info["dcp_size"] > 1 and info["enable_hierarchical_cache"]
+        cls.page_size = info["page_size"] * info["dcp_size"]
+        cls.capacity = info["internal_states"][0]["memory_usage"]["token_capacity"]
+
+    def generate(self, ids, output=32):
+        return _generate(self.base_url, ids, output, return_logprob=True)
+
+    def test_host_restore(self):
+        def prompt(seed):
+            return [seed + i % 97 for i in range(1025)]
+
+        _flush_cache(self.base_url)
+        ids = prompt(1000)
+        self.assertEqual(self.generate(ids)["meta_info"]["cached_tokens"], 0)
+        warm = self.generate(ids)
+        self.assertGreater(warm["meta_info"]["cached_tokens_details"]["device"], 0)
+        # Distinct prefixes overwrite L1 while the original survives in L2.
+        for i in range(math.ceil(self.capacity / len(ids)) + 1):
+            self.generate(prompt(2000 + i), output=1)
+        restored = self.generate(ids)
+        hits = restored["meta_info"]["cached_tokens_details"]
+        self.assertEqual(hits["device"], 0)
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(
+            hits["host"], len(ids) // self.page_size * self.page_size
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(warm["output_ids"], restored["output_ids"])
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _extract_output_logprobs(warm), _extract_output_logprobs(restored)
+        )
+        _flush_cache(self.base_url)
+        self.assertEqual(self.generate(ids, output=1)["meta_info"]["cached_tokens"], 0)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
